Confidential information that is basic data shall 1 be maintained as confidential and held without public access 2 for a period of one year from the spud date or the date of the 3 commencement of recompletion of the well. A one-year extension 4 of confidentiality may be granted upon written request received 5 by the department within sixty days of the expiration of the 6 initial one-year period. 7 b. Confidential information that is interpretive data shall 8 be maintained as confidential and held without public access 9 for a period of three years from the spud date or the date 10 of the commencement of recompletion of the well. For purposes of this section: 15 a. “Basic data” means any samples and data collected 16 during drilling and raw data provided directly by down hole 17 instruments, including but not limited to cuttings, cores, 18 sidewall cores, mud logs, mechanical logs, geophysical or 19 electrical logs, drill-stem tests, cuttings and core sample 20 intervals, and borehole deviations. 21 b. “Interpretive data” means data that has been interpreted 22 by the owner or service provider, including but not limited 23 to borehole imagery, petrophysical analysis, and geochemical 24 analysis. > 25 17.
